summary: Explain native chain startup waits and distinguish upstream sync targets
details: Before the native chain container starts, progress explains the first unmet snapshot, Bitcoin foreground, balance-history or indexer readiness gate using the current observations. Bitcoin catch-up waits include the remaining block count; chain initialization failures retain priority.

The default and detailed panels label balance-history's target source and the indexer's available upstream stable height, including stale observations and configured height caps. Indexer READY does not imply that Bitcoin has caught up.
Incomplete progress ranges no longer round up to 100.00 percent in text output. Raw progress precision, consensus readiness, startup gates and persisted node data remain unchanged.
